name: Thai Chicken Larb

ingredients.name: granulated sugar, plus extra as desired
lime juice, plus extra as desired
fish sauce, plus extra as desired
dried red chile flakes, plus extra as desired
shallots, peeled and sliced into thin rings

instructions.primary_message: Trim chicken of visible fat and cut into 2.5-cm cubes. Place in single layer on tray and freeze until partially frozen, about 30 minutes. Working in 2 or 3 batches, pulse chicken in food processor until roughly ground into pieces the size of small peas; set aside.

In a large 30-cm skillet (or wok), heat the chicken stock over medium-high heat with the oil, sugar, and salt. Add the chicken and the garlic, and cook until the chicken is just cooked through, stirring and breaking up the chicken, about 2 to 3 minutes. Stir in the lime juice, fish sauce, and chili flakes. Stir in the shallots, mint, and cilantro.
Stir in the ground toasted rice. Season to taste with more sugar, lime juice, fish sauce, and chili flakes as desired. Serve the larb warm or room temperature rice and lettuce.

schema_metadata.keywords: chicken, chicken dinner, dinners, larb, quick, weeknight dinners

description: This healthy dish of ground chicken, shallots, mint, and cilantro is full of fresh and hot Southeast Asian flavors. Serve it as a crispy lettuce wrap or over rice. It can be on the table in under 30 minutes.
notes:
Total time, including resting: 50 min.

Optional substitutions: iceberg leaf lettuce → green leaf lettuce
author: Yvonne Ruperti
